entries.effect: encodes the source with the codec of the algorithm and writes it at the destination, answering the number of bytes written; 0 when the output does not fit or the source cannot be encoded; a NULL scratch buffer is allocated by the layer; the framing of each algorithm is in facts/Compression/CompressionBuffer.md
entries.source: the declaration of the Compression header of the SDK (the name and the signature); the output of the host's libcompression for LZFSE, ZLIB, LZ4, LZ4_RAW and LZMA, measured on macOS in tests/backports/host/compression

entries.effect: decodes the source into the destination and answers the number of bytes written; a destination too short gets its first bytes and answers the destination size (LZFSE, ZLIB, LZ4 and LZ4_RAW), and answers 0 for LZMA, as the host does; corrupt input answers 0; two differences from the host are open and named in facts/Compression/CompressionBuffer.md: ZLIB truncated streams, and LZ4_RAW with a destination one byte short of the output for two inputs over 64 KiB
entries.source: the declaration of the Compression header of the SDK (the name and the signature); the output of the host's libcompression, measured on macOS in tests/backports/host/compression
